verdict.rationale: Wave is an accounting SaaS with a live GraphQL endpoint, so scoped API credentials for an agent is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence documents no API token or scope issuance. The admin/editor/viewer roles are human user-access controls, an adjacent feature rather than least-privilege API credentials. The developer portal could not be crawled.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
